modifiedDate.description: The date when this reply was last modified.

verb.description: The action this reply performed to the parent comment. When creating a new reply this is the action to be perform tSo the parent comment. Possible values are: * `resolve` - To resolve a comment. * `reopen` - To reopen (un-resolve) a comment.

selfLink.description: A link back to this list.

ParentList.description: A list of a file's parents.

items.description: The list of comments. If nextPageToken is populated, then this list may be incomplete and an additional page of results should be fetched.

selfLink.description: A link back to this list.

nextLink.description: A link to the next page of comments.

nextPageToken.description: The page token for the next page of comments. This will be absent if the end of the comments list has been reached. If the token is rejected for any reason, it should be discarded, and pagination should be restarted from the first page of results.

CommentList.description: A list of comments on a file in Google Drive.

kind.description: Output only. Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"drive#generateCseTokenResponse"`.

fileId.description: The fileId for which the JWT was generated.

currentKaclsName.description: Name of the KACLs that the returned KACLs ID points to.

currentKaclsId.description: The current Key ACL Service (KACLS) ID associated with the JWT.

jwt.description: The signed JSON Web Token (JWT) for the file.

GenerateCseTokenResponse.description: JWT and associated metadata used to generate CSE files.
